issue_context.title: Cache OpenAPI schema in memory-cached discovery client
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:

Cache the OpenAPI schema in the `OpenAPISchema` method rather than re-fetching it on every call to this method.

**Why is this needed**:

The API call to retrieve the OpenAPI schema is fairly slow, so it would be helpful to cache the response in the memory-cached discovery client.

review_comments:
I didn't look at which openapi schema/spec this client is fetching. Note that CRD and aggregated apiserver can dynamically change the aggregated openapi spec we have.

I'd prefer we caching the ETag returned from apiserver and utilizing it in the [client](https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/e318746e79ead3763c2c1e9999ac7e7d90b725f9/discovery/discovery_client.go#L421) (I didn't look into it, but I assume this is the underlying client being used)

see related implementation for using ETag client side: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/83147

I'm not very familiar with this code, so I need some help to understand. It appears that the delegate call resolves to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c409446d41924bccb4183a87e605179db38228e5/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/discovery/discovery_client.go#L420-L441

Are you suggesting to update this `OpenAPISchema` method to use ETags?
Yes. Using ETags in `DiscoveryClient` makes everyone who uses `DiscoveryClient` more efficient.
